title: Proposal
description: One row of a platform proposals table, as build.proposals reads it. A proposal asks the repository to make a change; it is never the change. The applier re-derives everything it writes with the repository's own deterministic tooling, so nothing in a proposal is copied into sources/. See docs/operations/proposals-bridge.md.

proposal_id.description: Stable id the producer assigns, unique across the table. The same observation proposed twice carries the same id, so a re-run of the producer adds nothing.

kind.description: What the proposal asks for. Each kind has one handler in build/proposals.py and one ADR-004 label.

axis.description: The axis the proposal concerns. A redate proposal is limited to openness by the same refusal build.reverify applies.

observed_at.description: The day the producer made the observation. A redate proposal whose axis is already verified on or after this day is current and is skipped.

producer.description: Which platform model or rule produced the row, so a reviewer can trace it and a bad producer can be switched off.

evidence.description: What the producer saw, per cited source. Informational: the applier fetches every source again and decides from its own reading.

created_at.description: When the row was written. The applier reads only rows inside its window (--since-days).
